claims.statement: Joe Goss stood up a little while against Tom Allen in Kentucky, which was his last appearance in the ring.
claims.excerpt: stood upa little while against ‘‘'Tom’’ Allen

claims.statement: After the fight with Tom Allen, Joe Goss was arrested and sentenced to pay a $250 fine; unable to pay, he was imprisoned for 250 days.
claims.excerpt: After the fight he was arrested, and sentenced to pay a fine of $250.

fights.excerpt: stood upa little while against ‘‘'Tom’’ Allen
fights.notes: This item does not say who won. Item 616 says Goss won on a foul.

notes: Allen appears only as Goss's opponent in the Kentucky fight.
